instruction.text: Computers have lots of different programs, which are represented by symbols. Match the symbols to the correct programs.

feedback.correct: In the recycle bin, you can find deleted files, images and programs.
Internet browsers allow access to the internet.
By clicking on the email symbol, you can access your email account to send or receive emails.
Using a video player program, you can watch videos.

instruction.text: Find the symbol that will open a program where you can type a text.

feedback.correct: That’s right! This symbol will open a writing program. To open a program on your computer, you usually have to double-click on it.

feedback.wrong: Not quite! This symbol will open a calendar for making a note of important dates or appointments.
Not quite! This symbol will open a computer game.

atoms.text: When you open a writing program, it will look something like this. The cursor flashes to let you know where on the page you are typing.

instruction.text: Use the keyboard to copy the sentence written on the computer screen. Pay attention to any capital letters and punctuation.

feedback.wrong: Make sure you have included the correct capital letters and punctuation marks!
